content.summary: Equipment rental company United Rentals (NYSE:URI) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025 as sales rose 2.8% year on year to $4.21 billion. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $17.05 billion at the midpoint.
